name: Holy Cross St Matthew and St Gilbert, Eccles
shortName: Holy Cross St Matthew and St Gilbert

boundary.description: From the point where Bridgewater Way (water line) crosses Barton Road (near M60 junction 13) E along Bridgewater Way, Green Lane, Liverpool Road, Mellor Street (including both sides), Renshaw Avenue, Trafford Road, Fairless Road, E along Barton Lane to its junction with Ashbourne Road, and S by a beeline to Manchester Ship Canal. Then W by the canal to the point and by a beeline to and along SW border of Boysnope Park Golf Club and by a footpath crossing Raspberry Lane and Twelve Yards Road to the railway. W along the railway and N by a Wigan – Salford District boundary to Bridgewater Canal. Then E by the Canal and Bridgewater Way to the point it crosses Barton Road.
